gloss: to search all over; to hunt around

definitions.gloss: to search all over; to hunt around
definitions.explanation: To go from place to place looking for someone or something: around the house, all over town, from shop to shop. Stresses the moving about and the effort, not whether the thing was found.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家中|いえじゅう}→家中：31767_iejuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探|さが}し{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: I searched all over the house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探|さが}し{回|まわ}った⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I hunted all over for the keys, but couldn't find them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧じゅう{探|さが}し{回|まわ}ったこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I once searched the whole neighbourhood for our cat, which had run off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{何軒|なんけん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探|さが}し{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: Looking for the limited-edition game console, I went round shop after shop from the morning on.

notes:
Transitive and godan: {探|さが}し{回|まわ}る, {探|さが}し{回|まわ}った. A compound of ⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (to look for) and ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around). The thing sought takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, and so can the area searched (⟦{町中|まちじゅう}→町中：28383_machijuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探|さが}し{回|まわ}る).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{探|さが}し{回|まわ}る: to search frantically
- ⟦{町中|まちじゅう}→町中：28383_machijuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探|さが}し{回|まわ}る: to search all over town
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧{探|さが}し{回|まわ}る: to look here and there

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{探|さが}し{出|だ}す→探し出す：32526_sagashidasu⟧: to track down — the search ends in finding
- ⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for — the plain verb
